description: Works out the delay time in milliseconds of every note value at a tempo, and sends each one out as a voltage

params.text: Sets the tempo the note values are worked out from, 30 to 300 beats per minute

inputs.text: A clock patched here sets the tempo from its own rate, in place of the knob

outputs.text: The delay time of a whole note at the tempo, 0V to 10V covering 0 to 10 seconds
The delay time of a dotted half note at the tempo, 0V to 10V covering 0 to 10 seconds
The delay time of a half note at the tempo, 0V to 10V covering 0 to 10 seconds
The delay time of a half-note triplet at the tempo, 0V to 10V covering 0 to 10 seconds
The delay time of a dotted quarter note at the tempo, 0V to 10V covering 0 to 10 seconds
The delay time of a quarter note at the tempo, 0V to 10V covering 0 to 10 seconds
The delay time of a quarter-note triplet at the tempo, 0V to 10V covering 0 to 10 seconds
The delay time of a dotted eighth note at the tempo, 0V to 10V covering 0 to 10 seconds
The delay time of an eighth note at the tempo, 0V to 10V covering 0 to 10 seconds
The delay time of an eighth-note triplet at the tempo, 0V to 10V covering 0 to 10 seconds
The delay time of a dotted sixteenth note at the tempo, 0V to 10V covering 0 to 10 seconds
The delay time of a sixteenth note at the tempo, 0V to 10V covering 0 to 10 seconds
The delay time of a sixteenth-note triplet at the tempo, 0V to 10V covering 0 to 10 seconds
The delay time of a dotted thirty-second note at the tempo, 0V to 10V covering 0 to 10 seconds
The delay time of a thirty-second note at the tempo, 0V to 10V covering 0 to 10 seconds
The delay time of a thirty-second-note triplet at the tempo, 0V to 10V covering 0 to 10 seconds

notes: A clock at the EXT input takes over from the BPM knob only after two of its pulses have arrived.
The BPM knob sets the tempo again if the pulses at the EXT input stop for 2 seconds or change their spacing.
A clock working out faster than 999 beats per minute is not used, and the display reads OOR.

inputs.0: high above 1V · stepped · one channel only
